report.scenario: A technician wearing smart glasses packs a mobile laser scanner (Navvis M6) away into its transport boxes, following an expert's remote guidance.

questions.ask: Does this video itself show the technician fitting a lens cap onto an M6 lens, not merely holding a cap near the lens?
Does this video itself show the technician separating the M6 head from the rest of the scanner, not merely repositioning or handling the assembled scanner?
Does this video itself show the technician placing the detached M6 head inside the head box, not merely setting it beside or on top of the box?
Does this video itself show the technician removing an M6 battery from the scanner, not merely touching or inspecting a battery that remains installed?
Does this video itself show the technician inserting the disassembled M6 body into the neck box, not merely placing the body next to the box?
Does this video itself show the technician placing the M6 wheels and wheel unit inside the wheel box, not merely handling or setting them beside the box?
Does this video itself show the technician shutting a transport-box lid, not merely placing an open lid on the box without closing it?
Does this video itself show the technician locking the head box to the battery box while the head box is stacked on top, not merely stacking the boxes or handling a latch?
